subject: openclaw
tagline: Personal AI assistant you run on your own devices; multi-channel inbox plus local-first Gateway

modules.name: src
modules.description: Gateway core: channels, agents, commands, CLI wiring, context-engine, canvas-host, cron, gateway protocol

modules.name: extensions
modules.description: 113 bundled plugins, including 25 messaging channel extensions, model providers, voice/TTS/STT, memory backends

modules.name: apps
modules.description: Companion apps for android, ios, macos, shared SwiftUI/Kotlin sources

modules.name: skills
modules.description: 53 bundled agent skills (apple-notes, clawhub, coding-agent, obsidian, etc)

capabilities.name: Local-first Gateway
capabilities.description: Single control plane binding loopback by default; typed protocol between Gateway and nodes

capabilities.name: Companion native apps (macOS, iOS, Android)
capabilities.description: SwiftUI (macOS/iOS) + Kotlin (Android) native clients paired over Gateway WebSocket

capabilities.name: Voice Wake + Talk Mode
capabilities.description: Wake words + continuous voice with ElevenLabs + TTS fallbacks (per README)

capabilities.name: Live Canvas (A2UI)
capabilities.description: Agent-driven visual workspace with A2UI bundle

capabilities.name: Skills system (53 bundled + ClawHub)
capabilities.description: Bundled skills + ClawHub marketplace for third-party skills

capabilities.name: Plugin SDK (versioned public contract)
capabilities.description: Public versioned cross-package contract for channel/provider/tool plugins

capabilities.name: MCP bridge via mcporter
capabilities.description: MCP integration routed through external mcporter (decoupled from core runtime)

capabilities.name: Pluggable memory (4 backends)
capabilities.description: Memory is a single-slot plugin (one active); ships with multiple options including LanceDB

capabilities.name: Multi-agent routing (per-agent sessions)
capabilities.description: Route inbound channels/accounts/peers to isolated agents (workspaces + per-agent sessions)

capabilities.name: Docker sandboxing for non-main sessions
capabilities.description: Per-session Docker sandboxes configurable for non-main sessions

capabilities.name: DM pairing policy + allowlists
capabilities.description: Pairing codes for unknown senders; per-channel allow-from lists

capabilities.name: Cron service (durable)
capabilities.description: Built-in cron with store, schedule, jobs, delivery plan

capabilities.name: Remote access (Tailscale, SSH)
capabilities.description: Remote gateway control over Tailscale and SSH per docs

plugins.mechanism: Bundled plugins in extensions/ + published contract via packages/plugin-package-contract; npm-distributed third-party plugins

channel_plugins.mechanism: Typed channel-contract in src/plugin-sdk/channel-contract.ts; 25 bundled channel extensions

provider_plugins.mechanism: Typed provider-entry; auto-enable hooks; SecretRef auth

hooks.mechanism: hooks.internal.entries in config; gateway protocol events

mcp.note: MCP via external mcporter bridge (not first-class in core)

unique_selling_points: Widest messaging channel coverage observed here (25 bundled channel extensions)
Native companion apps on macOS, iOS, Android (SwiftUI + Kotlin)
Live Canvas (A2UI) surface for agent-driven visual output
Local-first Gateway with typed node pairing protocol
Voice Wake + Talk Mode with ElevenLabs + system TTS fallback
Strict plugin/extension architectural boundaries enforced by contract

limitations.description: No first-class MCP server runtime in core; MCP integration delegated to external mcporter
Terminal-first setup by design; onboarding flows intentionally not hidden
Memory is single-slot (only one memory plugin active at a time)
